ValidationRule.description: Validated Period End Date should be future date in BL record
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.EHISBypassValidationRuleCustomPermission ), NOT(ISBLANK( PeriodStart )), NOT(ISBLANK( PeriodEnd )), PeriodEnd <= PeriodStart )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Period End Date cannot be before Period Start Date.
